newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt gives Nigeria drug smuggler 25 yrs in jail.
newsitem.headline: Egypt gives Nigeria drug smuggler 25 yrs in jail.

text.p: An Egyptian court on Wednesday sentenced a Nigerian man to 25 years in jail for trying to smuggle 71 capsules filled with heroin, security sources said.
They said Adam Gibreel Abu Bakr was caught about three months ago at Cairo airport while he was transitting en route to the Saudi Arabian port of Jeddah from Nigeria.
Police found the capsules in his intestines. The amount of heroin they contained is unknown.
The sources said the court also fined Abu Bakr 200,000 pounds ($59,000).
